fields.label: Parcel, premises or vehicle identifier
fields.official_field: B.b. Número de identificación de la parcela, o en su caso, local o medio de transporte tratado

fields.label: Adviser identification where applicable
fields.official_field: B.d. en su caso, del asesor

fields.label: Crop species and variety
fields.official_field: B.e. Cultivo, indicando especie y variedad

fields.label: Product used for herbaceous crops sown with treated seed
fields.official_field: B.e. Si es cultivo herbáceo y la siembra se realiza con semilla tratada, indicar el producto utilizado

fields.label: Treated area for a field treatment
fields.official_field: B.f. Superficie tratada expresada en hectáreas

fields.label: Treated volume where applicable (premises)
fields.official_field: B.f. En los casos en que proceda, como tratamiento de locales, el volumen tratado expresado en metros cúbicos

fields.label: Machine or equipment identification, including registration where applicable
fields.official_field: B.h. Identificación de la maquina o equipo de tratamiento empleado, indicando cuando proceda el número de registro

fields.label: Product quantity used in the treatment; retain kg or L
fields.official_field: B.i. Kilogramos. o litros del producto fitosanitario utilizados en el tratamiento

fields.label: Assessment of treatment effectiveness
fields.official_field: B.j. Valoración de la eficacia del tratamiento

limitations: National Annex III Part I.B treatment-row subset only. General holding/parcel information in Part I.A, fertilisation/irrigation records in I.C and non-agricultural records in Part II are not mapped here.
One of treated area in hectares or applicable treated volume in cubic metres is needed according to the treatment context. The optional markers do not waive that conditional requirement.
B.i is the total kg or litres of product used, not a dose in kg/ha or L/ha. Do not silently convert between total quantity and application rate.
No regional CUE import schema, SIGPAC reconciliation, electronic log transmission, pesticide legality or CAP eligibility decision is implemented.
The inspected consolidated BOE text is informative; the original official publications and subsequent applicable changes require qualified review.
This draft does not certify that a complete 2026 EU electronic-record format is represented. Preserve date and unit literals and obtain the region's accepted representation before filing.
